title: Asking for directions
instructions: Bir turist postaneyi soruyor. Kısa bir diyalog; yönlere ve yerlere dikkat et.

script.speaker: man
script.text: Excuse me, where is the post office?

script.speaker: woman
script.text: Go straight on and turn right at the bank.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: The post office is next to the supermarket.

script.speaker: woman
script.text: No, it's about five minutes on foot.

questions.prompt: What is the man looking for?
questions.feedback: Postaneyi (post office) soruyor. Banka ve süpermarket yol tarifindeki yerler.
questions.evidence: Excuse me, where is the post office?

questions.feedback: Düz gidip bankadan (at the bank) sağa dönecek.

questions.prompt: What is next to the post office?
questions.feedback: Postane süpermarketin yanında (next to the supermarket).
questions.evidence: The post office is next to the supermarket.

questions.prompt: How long does it take on foot?
questions.feedback: Yürüyerek yaklaşık beş dakika (five minutes). "Fifteen" ve "fifty" ile karıştırma.
questions.evidence: it's about five minutes on foot.
